subject.title: feat(channels): status line on in-flight progress drafts

question: Should omitted `channels.<channel>.streaming.progress.status` enable the new visible status line for all compositor-backed channels, or should this feature be explicitly Telegram-scoped until each channel renderer adopts it?
rationale: The patch adds a defaulted shared configuration key but only changes Telegram’s compositor call site, while the user-visible docs describe a per-channel setting; maintainers must choose the durable compatibility and ownership boundary.

options.title: Support all compositor channels
options.body: Wire the resolved mode into every compositor-backed channel, add renderer coverage, and retain the channel-generic configuration contract.

options.title: Scope it to Telegram for now
options.body: Restrict validation, docs, and configuration metadata so unsupported channels cannot silently accept a setting that has no effect.

options.title: Defer the default
options.body: Keep the implementation behind an explicit opt-in until maintainers approve the cross-channel upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Support all compositor channels
recommendation.body: Wire the resolved mode into every compositor-backed channel, add renderer coverage, and retain the channel-generic configuration contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed implementation and its documented channel scope originate on this branch, although current-main ownership evidence was unavailable.
